fields.english: Defeat $1oa Deadwood Den Guardians and return to Brerufa.
fields.thai: กำจัดผู้พิทักษ์รัง Deadwood {world1} ตัว แล้วกลับไปหา Brerufa

source_record.description:
Barkskin stand on weak roots. Deadwood claw at our land, each day their rot digs deep, sinks more. We cannot hold alone. 

Deadwood Den guards are the brunt of their strength. If you seek our trust, strike down those who foul the wood. When their Guardians fall, the rest of their tribe will weaken. We even our odds.

Bring them down, for balance, and help keep Hyjal whole.
source_record.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Deadwood Den Guardians and return to Brerufa.
source_record.title: Balance Through Strength

Listen, demon caster. There have been some awfully noisy visitors just up the mountain. Like you, they taint the land with their foul demon magic and experimenting with piles of ash. It's high time we investigate.

By we, I mean you.

I want you to poke around and investigate their camp! See if you can bring me some notes on what your fellows have been up to. Surely with egos that large they've written something we can utilize. Perhaps they are carrying something on their person?

So in order to really disrupt operations here and get me out of this cage, we're going to have to kill four very powerful mortals. This cage has demonic wards on it that won't be dispelled until all four are dead, and that key can't be used until the wards are down.

Look, you seem like |5$r that can hold your own but I'm going to need a bit more convincing that you can actually take on these stupid warlocks before I give you any good info.

Like killing a ton of these warlocks for starters. Easy, no?

source_record.description:
Listen, I know you can smell the fel blood pools behind me and I'm sure you've seen the crystals that grow out of them. These crystals have special properties from the ashes of Archimonde that rain down on this side of the hill.

Something about how they are formed makes them especially good at draining fel energies, which is a big problem for someone like me, but they can still have their uses.

I want you to gather some for me. Try and get a few kinds. I'll know what I need when I see it.
source_record.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Fel-Slime Crystals and $2oa Pristine Fel-Slime Crystal.

source_record.description:
Listen here, $c. It seems we're in quite the sticky situation. I knew those blasted demon casters were up to no good, but this is far worse than I had expected.

Good thing I have an idea!

For this to work I will need fel-slime from the surrounding slime creatures that can be found in the fel blood pools behind me. Not the bones or bits, just the slime! Make sure you wipe your hands after handling it. It seems to be corrosive.

Not to fear, I'm sure you'll find a way to bring it back to me.
source_record.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Fel-Slime Ooze.

source_record.description:
I've known these hills since I was a hatchling. If there is one thing I know, it's that pinecones can solve a lot of problems.

Probably not what you expected, eh?

<The crow winks at you, conspiratorially.>

Go fetch me some; it's part of a little scheme I'm hatching. I promise you it will be worth the effort.

You should be able to find them under any healthy or living tree nearby. Stay away from those corrupted ones though, those pinecones aren't any good!
source_record.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Prickly Pinecones under healthy trees.
source_record.title: Prickly Pinecones

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Ortak looks alarmed as you approach but calms as it becomes clear you aren't Scourge.>

You...you are not Scourge? But you are undead? How is this possible...?

Well, stranger, if you are offering to aid us here I will not turn you away. We have been trapped here since the end of the war. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

I would ask a favor of you, if you are willing. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.

source_record.description:
Could this be? Travelers have returned to Hyjal!

I can hardly believe it! Perhaps with your aid we will finally be freed of this place. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

Please, $c. I would ask a favor of you. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.
source_record.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Hyjal Silphium.
source_record.title: Herbs for the Bruised and Weary

You know, they packed enough tools to get the essentials started, but there's never enough fastening material. Only so much cordage-winding my hands can take.

Resourcefulness is even better than being prepared.

Take an empty bag to the burned-down remains of the alliance buildings around the Cradle of Tranquility southwest of here, and fill it with as many nails and brackets as you can find in the ashes.

source_record.description:
In addition to seeing to the spiritual needs of the people here, I feed them as well. I'm not exactly a trained cook, but after five years, I've learned a thing or two about preparing food!

I'm sure that folks here would love a taste of something different. I remember, before we assembled on the mountain, there was a goblin from Everlook who was serving platters of tiny, Savory Stag Sliders... I would love to taste one of those again. We have plenty of stags up here, too! Think you can cook some up?
source_record.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Savory Stag Sliders to Ortak Lomgok in Elderwild.

The Wormwing harpies have overrun much of this plateau. They reject our protector Aviana, and seek only to despoil the lands around us.

Blood has been spilled and must be repaid. Scatter their feathers to the wind.

source_record.description:
Say, while you're out and about prancing in my lands, would you mind doing me a favor?

Once the war had been won, many of the various armies up and left. For whatever reason, they decided some of their supplies were not worth taking. That, or they all died. Who could say?

Regardless, these supplies are of use to my kits and me. Unfortunately they also tend to be where the demons are. Take this tuft of fur with you and use it on the demons to distract them while you grab the tools.
source_record.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Supplies.
source_record.title: To Outfox a Demon

fields.english: Bring $1oa Felhound Spikes to Maerion Thaelemaches in Dae'gun.
fields.thai: นำหนามเฟลฮาวด์ {world1} ชิ้นไปให้ Maerion Thaelemaches ที่ Dae'gun

source_record.description:
Left bleeding and abandoned--thrown aside so an army could flee. I was meant to die buying them moments. 

Instead, I was cursed to endure, forced to watch ever-burning demons finish what steel could not. This is my fate.

But something is changing. Horde and Alliance return to this desecrated mountain, and war stirs again.

My fury answers it. 

If yours does as well, prove it. Bring me two handfuls of felhound spikes from these Defiling Hounds.

The pain will align our wills.
source_record.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Felhound Spikes to Maerion Thaelemaches in Dae'gun.
source_record.title: Maerion's Misery

fields.english: Kill $1oa Chillwind Ravagers and return to Rilan Howard in northern Winterspring.
fields.thai: สังหาร Chillwind Ravager {world1} ตัว แล้วกลับไปหา Rilan Howard ทางเหนือของ Winterspring

source_record.description:
These chimaeras are a cruel joke. Two tongues, both foul, snarling frost and hunger. As if this wasteland needed more teeth.

This clearing is all we have, constantly overcome by storms before we can settle further. The two-headed Chillwind Ravagers circle us, testing our resolve, bleeding our time.

We spend more hours driving them back than building anything of worth.

Cull them. Break their presence here. With fewer prowling beasts, we may yet carve something lasting from this frozen waste.
source_record.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Chillwind Ravagers and return to Rilan Howard in northern Winterspring.
source_record.title: Two-Headed Ravagers

fields.english: Bring $1oa Winterspring Chimaera Fur and $2oa Winterspring Owl Feathers to Evie Whirlbrew.
fields.thai: นำขนไคมีราแห่ง Winterspring {world1} ชิ้นและขนนกฮูกแห่ง Winterspring {world2} ขนไปให้ Evie Whirlbrew

source_record.description:
Folks have been trying to get onto Mount Hyjal since the end of the war, but there's one big problem... all the demons in Darkwhisper Gorge!

I think I have the solution. A concoction made from locally-sourced ingredients might be able to make the drinker blend in with the Winterspring surroundings so that creatures here can't see you as easily.

I'd love to test this theory, if you're game for bringing me a few small things!
source_record.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Winterspring Chimaera Fur and $2oa Winterspring Owl Feathers to Evie Whirlbrew.

fields.thai: สังหาร Blackthorne Adept {world1} คน และ Wild-branded Cultist {world2} คน

source_record.description:
The lands surrounding the Well of Eternity are overrun with followers of the Wild King. Many once stood beside us, bound by the same oaths, but their devotion has curdled into reckless zeal. They actively hinder our efforts to tend Nordrassil and protect the Well.

I will not pretend this is easy, nor that my hands will be clean. Still, we cannot allow them to harm our land or strike our flank when the greater incursion begins.

Thin their ranks swiftly, and may Elune forgive what necessity demands.
source_record.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Blackthorne Adepts and $2oa Wild-branded Cultists.

fields.english: Use the Enchanted Branch to release $1oa wisps around Nordrassil.
fields.thai: ใช้กิ่งไม้ลงมนตร์ (Enchanted Branch) ปลดปล่อยวิสป์ {world1} ดวงรอบ Nordrassil

source_record.description:
$n, the ancestral spirits called to Hyjal during the great battle weren't all lost. Some linger still, drawn to Nordrassil after the great sacrifice. These wisps have stayed within the root canopy that hangs over the well, trapped in a state of purgatory between this world and the next.

Use this enchanted branch to bring peace to these wisps, joining their memories with eternity.

You need not release them all yourself. Recover the will of five and return the branch to us.
source_record.objectivesText: Use the Enchanted Branch to release $1oa wisps around Nordrassil.
source_record.title: Memory Mist

source_record.description:
If you're headed into Shaper's Terrace, I would ask a favor of you.

There are reports of slimes that live in the pools by the colorless Achromatic Crystal. I believe their essence could be of use in my experiments, and would like you to bring me some samples for study.

I will make it worth your while.

fields.thai: นำ Mote of Unstable Magic {world1} ชิ้นไปให้ Nuara Tremorhoof

source_record.description:
Any experienced shaman who attempts to scry the elemental plane can tell you that there is a blip of sorts, a distortion that you feel as you cross over to the other realms of existence.

We have need of adventurers like yourself to help us better understand this disturbance. Take this Elemental Attractor. You will be able to extract motes of unstable magic with it from the most skilled spellcasters and other powerful entities you may encounter. Bring me these motes so that we may study them.
source_record.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Motes of Unstable Magic to Nuara Tremorhoof.
